Subject: Request: evaluation plan + timeline for Redwood pilot

Thanks again for today's demo — the team found the latency and cost controls compelling. Procurement and the platform team asked if we could get a formal evaluation playbook and a milestone roadmap they can share internally.

Top asks from Archway:
- A one-page mutual action plan (MAP) we can use in the procurement packet
- A simple milestone slide deck that shows technical and procurement gating (SOC2 evidence, data residency questions)
- Suggested timeline for a 6–8 week evaluation and a recommended decision date window

Can you share a template and an initial draft we can iterate on? We have a quarterly goal to finalize vendors by end of Q1 2027, so anything that helps speed procurement review will be great.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Clarke

Ben — great to hear the demo resonated. Attached are two starting artifacts: a compact evaluation playbook (Google Doc link below) and a milestone roadmap slide deck. Both are intentionally lightweight so you can drop them into procurement and technical review packets.

What I included in the playbook (high level):
- Executive goal & scope (what success looks like)
- Key milestones and owners (tech, security, procurement, legal)
- Acceptance criteria per milestone (latency SLAs, integration checklist)
- Evidence/artifacts to attach for procurement (SOC2 report, data flow diagram, audit log example)
- Risk & mitigation plan (fallback models, regional routing)

Recommended timeline (configurable):
- Week 0: Kickoff + access (credentials, test data guidance)
- Week 1–2: Integration & smoke tests (API keys, routing, initial perf)
- Week 3–4: Workload eval + cost profiling (batching, quantization suggestions)
- Week 5: Security/compliance review & SOC2 evidence handoff
- Week 6: Decision window / executive review

Quick asks for you: please add the names of any reviewers from your security and procurement teams directly to the doc so we can assign owners. Proposed kickoff slot: Tue 2026-10-06 10:00 PT — I can send a calendar invite if that works.

Playbook (draft): https://drive.google.com/document/d/1A_archway_playbook_draft
Milestone slides (v1): https://drive.google.com/presentation/d/1B_archway_milestone_slides_v1

Attachments: [archway_evaluation_playbook_draft.gdoc] (live doc), [archway_milestone_roadmap_v1.pptx] (slide deck)

Thanks,
